vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nginx-config
Version: 1.0.6

The skill bundle is a legitimate utility for generating Nginx configurations and performing basic system monitoring. The script `scripts/nginx.sh` safely generates configuration templates for reverse proxies, SSL, and load balancing based on user-provided arguments. The script `scripts/script.sh` provides system health checks (CPU, memory, disk usage) and log viewing, which is consistent with its stated purpose as a monitoring tool. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection was found.

llm.summary: The skill's files and runtime instructions align with its stated purpose (generating nginx configs and providing server/ops helpers); it reads some local system info/logs but does not request external credentials or install remote code.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (nginx config, reverse proxy, SSL, caching, hardening, optimization) match the included generator (scripts/nginx.sh) and ops helper (scripts/script.sh). The helper script's monitoring/ops features are within the broader '服务器/运维' scope described.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md is an instruction wrapper and is consistent (run nginx-config help etc.). The included scripts access local system state (e.g., /proc/cpuinfo, /var/log/syslog, df, uptime) and write logs to a per-user data directory; this is expected for an ops tool but worth noting because it reads local logs and system info.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or remote download. The skill is instruction-only with embedded scripts; nothing in the manifest pulls code from external URLs or creates non-standard system installs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables or credentials declared. The scripts optionally respect NGINX_CONFIG_DIR/XDG_DATA_HOME/HOME and reference standard system paths (e.g., /etc/letsencrypt) appropriate for nginx tooling. No unrelated secrets requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent platform privileges or modify other skills. The helper writes into its own data directory under the user's home by default.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent with its description. Before running: (1) inspect the included scripts (nginx.sh and script.sh) yourself — they output configs and read local system info/logs but do not exfiltrate data or require credentials; (2) avoid running them as root unless you intend to apply changes to system paths (they reference /etc/letsencrypt and /var/log paths); (3) if you don't want local log reads, don't run the monitoring/log commands in script.sh; and (4) because there is no install sandboxing, prefer to run in a controlled environment or review the files if you have sensitive data on the machine.
